author: Michael Rodriguez
description: Muse Bridge — Muse Spark desktop app: chat with Muse Spark, run approval-gated desktop tasks, and bridge results between ChatGPT (Dot) and Muse via clipboard + a shared Bridge folder.
name: muse-bridge

scripts.check: for f in main.js preload.js src/*.js renderer/*.js tests/*.js scripts/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo ALL FILES SYNTAX OK
scripts.test: node tests/pathResolver.test.js && node tests/sessionGuard.test.js && node tests/vault.test.js && node tests/totp.test.js && node tests/noSecrets.test.js && node tests/regression.test.js && node tests/updater.test.js && node tests/lessons.test.js && node tests/sparkVision.test.js && node tests/attachments.test.js && node tests/loops.test.js && node tests/sops.test.js && node tests/requests.test.js
